==Description==
The '''Void''' was an exclusive boss only available via admin commands during certain 2020 private testing sessions, and has not been in the game in any way since. The only public showcase of this enemy was done in a video made by JOHN ROBLOX<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HENz0rjbAE4</ref>, which also contains footage of features that never made it out of private tests, such as certain UI elements. The enemy itself was made as a joke which was never going to make it into the actual game. It had a high amount of health, a slow speed and three abilities.

It had three abilities:
#Its first ability was ''Stomp'', which stunned towers for around 5 seconds.
#Its second ability was ''Summon'', where it would summon multiple random enemies. These could be the [[Mystery]], [[Mystery Boss]], [[Glitch]], [[Lava]], [[Mega Slow]], [[Abnormal Boss]]es and [[Shadow Boss]].
#Its third ability, ''Rage'', only happened at half health. It made it scream and slowly turn its torso, leg and crown color from purple to red, then summoning four [[First Form]]s.

==Appearance==
The '''Void''' had black head and arms. Its torso and legs were purple in colors, and there is a large pink gem on its torso. It had multiple small humanoids protruding from its body. It also wore a purple crown. After ''Rage'', all its purple parts turned red, with the exception of the gem on its torso.

==Trivia==
*The '''Void''' is based on [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Void|the boss with the same name]] from ''Tower Battles''.
**Its regular appearance is a recreation of the third version of the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Void|Void]].
**Its ''Rage'' appearance is a recreation of the second version of the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Void|Void]].
**The [[First Form]]s it spawns are a recreation of the first version of the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Void|Void]].
*The '''Void's''' crown is a retextured version of {{RLinkC|1125510|The Void Star}} accessory from the Roblox Catalog.
